patch.value: Make automated dependency refresh satisfy required PR checks through an eligible event

Validated CodeRabbit #89 finding: GitHub Docs state workflow_dispatch job checks on a PR head are not evaluated as required PR status checks. The certification task explicitly requires dispatching ci.yml with GITHUB_TOKEN after creation; that execution repair is implemented and tested, but it cannot by itself clear branch-rule checks. Preserve the requested dispatch and owner publishing gates. Owner must select an eligible PR/push event path, such as an appropriately scoped GitHub App token for PR creation, or the documented approval-required GITHUB_TOKEN PR workflow path. No credentials or repository rules were changed.

Read official Troubleshooting required status checks section Checks from some workflow jobs are not evaluated; compare dependency-refresh.yml final gh workflow run command and ci.yml workflow_dispatch trigger. Do not run dependency-refresh or publish to reproduce.
An automation-created refresh PR has all four required check names evaluated at its exact head through an eligible workflow event, with owner publishing gates unchanged.

Explicit dispatch executes CI, but GitHub Docs exclude workflow_dispatch job checks from required PR status checks. The requested dispatch and name-preservation tests pass; automatic branch-rule satisfaction is unresolved.
